## Overview

This assignment introduces reproducible data generation, basic data manipulation with `dplyr`, and visualization with `ggplot2`. A simulated dataset of limb measurements is generated and summarized by organism and observer.

```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Generate the reproducible measurement dataset.
source("dataGenerato.R")

# Import the generated measurements.
measurements <- read.csv("measurements.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Calculate limb volume by approximating each limb as a cylinder.
# Volume = pi * radius^2 * length, where radius = width / 2.
measurements <- measurements %>%
  mutate(volume = pi * (Limb_width / 2)^2 * Limb_legnth)

head(measurements)
```

```{r summarize}
# Sort observations by organism, observer, and calculated limb volume.
measurements_sorted <- measurements %>%
  arrange(Organism, Observer, volume)

head(measurements_sorted)
```

```{r averages}
# Calculate mean limb volume for each organism.
average_volume <- measurements_sorted %>%
  group_by(Organism) %>%
  summarize(
    Average_volume = mean(volume),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

average_volume
```

```{r observers}
# Count observations contributed by each observer for each organism.
observer_count <- measurements_sorted %>%
  count(Organism, Observer, name = "Count")

observer_count
```

```{r boxplot}
ggplot(measurements_sorted, aes(x = Organism, y = volume, fill = Organism)) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Limb Volume Distribution by Organism",
    x = "Organism",
    y = "Limb volume"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r histogram}
ggplot(measurements_sorted, aes(x = volume)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, colour = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ Organism, scales = "free") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Limb Volume by Organism",
    x = "Limb volume",
    y = "Frequency"
  )
```
